Prefabricated Substation

Dry-Type Prefabricated Substation

A 35 kV and below prefabricated substation integrating primary equipment, transformer and low-voltage distribution. Its dry-type transformer configuration avoids oil leakage risk and suits renewable and environmentally sensitive sites.
